page.title: Marbella Starlite 2040: Pre-Concert Yacht Cruise from Puerto Banús

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Starlite venue?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is roughly 8 km (5 miles) from the Starlite auditorium in the Nagüeles quarry. A taxi takes 10–15 minutes and costs about €15–20. We recommend leaving the boat by 20:00 to arrive comfortably before the 21:00 curtain.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For a group of 8–10, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For larger parties up to 12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offer more deck space. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs – you just bring your swimwear and concert tickets.

faq.q: Can we customise the cruise timing for Starlite?
faq.a: Yes – we can set a 2-hour cruise from 17:00 to 19:00, or a 4-hour option from 15:00 to 19:00. Contact us via WhatsApp to confirm availability for your chosen date and we'll adjust the schedule to fit the concert start.

faq.q: Is there parking near Puerto Banús for Starlite guests?
faq.a: Puerto Banús has several paid car parks (e.g. the underground parking at the marina, about €2/hour). However, we recommend taking a taxi to avoid traffic. The taxi rank is a 2-minute walk from our berth at the end of Muelle de Honor.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If high winds or sea conditions make the cruise unsafe, we'll offer a full refund or reschedule. Generally, Marbella enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or decorations on board?
faq.a: Yes – you're welcome to bring a picnic, cake, or decorations (e.g. balloons for a birthday). We provide the standard snacks and drinks, but extra catering can be arranged via WhatsApp for a supplement. Glass bottles are allowed, but please be careful with breakables.

faq.q: How do I book a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link (deposit of 50% secures the booking). The balance is due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for Starlite dates.

data.body_html:
Combine the glamour of a sunset yacht cruise from Puerto Banús with a world-class concert at Starlite 2040. Depart directly from the marina, enjoy drinks and snacks on board, then take a short taxi ride to the Nagüeles quarry auditorium – all without the hassle of traffic or parking. Our fleet of 12m to 29m boats suits groups from 5 to 12 guests, with prices starting at €749 for a 2-hour charter (all inclusive).

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works

Starlite 2040 runs from June to August, with gates opening around 19:30 and concerts starting at 21:00. A 2-hour cruise from 17:00 to 19:00 gives you time to relax on the water, watch the sunset over La Concha, and arrive at the venue feeling refreshed. Taxis from Puerto Banús to the auditorium take 10–15 minutes – much faster than driving from Marbella centre.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8 m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7 m, 6 pax) are also available – prices on request via WhatsApp.

What’s Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full cruise duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine & cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance & safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

You only need to bring swimwear, sunscreen, and your concert tickets. The boat returns to the same berth in Puerto Banús.

Sample Itinerary for a Starlite Evening

17:00 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús (Muelle de Honor). Meet the skipper, stow bags, and enjoy welcome drinks.
17:15 – Depart east toward the Marbella coastline. Cruise past the Golden Mile, Cala del Faro, and the Sierra Blanca foothills.
18:00 – Anchor for a swim stop near Cala Cortés (weather permitting). Snacks and drinks served.
18:45 – Begin return cruise to Puerto Banús. Sunset views over La Concha.
19:00 – Dock and disembark. Taxi to Starlite (10 min). Arrive by 19:30 for pre-concert drinks at the venue.

How to Book

Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link (50% deposit secures the booking). Balance due 7 days before departure. For Starlite dates, book at least 2 weeks ahead – June to August is peak season. See all options on our Marbella boat rental page.
